plugins.name: The ROM Depot
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: NOT INSTALLABLE. The ROM Depot's API is clean and would be the easiest of the seven sites surveyed, but browsing requires a logged-in session and an RPP v1 plugin cannot hold one: ctx.http has no POST and clears its cookie jar before every request.
plugins.terms: This repository records a survey finding. It fetches, indexes and redistributes nothing.
plugins.comments: GET /api/getContents returns the entire directory tree as one unpaginated JSON document, but answers 401 unauthenticated; login is POST /api/login carried by a cookie. No login was attempted and the owner's account was not used, so the JSON schema is unverified -- which is why no parser is shipped. Two designs would work, both keeping the credential in the operator's browser: an operator-saved getContents export, or a Vimm-style companion capture extension. No password config key is declared on purpose: the plugin can never transmit one.
